## Checklist

- [ ] CI local executed (`pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run test`, `pnpm run build`)
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env`, tokens, keys)
- [ ] Backend contract impact reviewed (`server` routes/schema)
- [ ] Frontend behavior impact reviewed (`web` routes/UI states)
- [ ] If database changed: migration tested and rollback considered
- [ ] If infra changed: `server/infra` docs/config updated
